conflicts.permit: We may share this information within Wanelo and with Third Parties for our or their purposes in an anonymized or aggregated form that is designed to prevent anyone from identifying you.
conflicts.prohibit: Personal Information that you may provide for a friend or colleague will be used to send your friend or colleague the content or link you request, but will not be collected or otherwise used by Wanelo or any other Third Parties for any other purpose.
conflicts.situation: Using personal information provided about a friend to create and share anonymized or aggregated data with third parties.
conflicts.reason: The policy prohibits collecting or using a friend's details for any other purpose, but broadly permits using personal information to create and share anonymized data.
